items.title: Visa (V) Hands Over 6 Million Documents As DOJ Debit Card Case Drags On
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has delivered 6 million documents to the US Department of Justice as part of an ongoing government debit card lawsuit. The scale and duration of the proceedings highlight continued regulatory scrutiny of Visa's debit card practices.
